name: How can I tell if my current water heater installation is up to code?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my current water heater installation is up to code?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining if your current water heater installation is up to code often requires a professional assessment. While you can visually check for basic elements like seismic straps or a drain pan, local codes change, and an older installation might not meet current standards. A qualified plumber can inspect your unit for proper venting, T&P valve discharge, expansion tank presence, and other specific local requirements. We offer inspections to assess compliance and advise on necessary upgrades.
acceptedAnswer.description: A professional assessment is the best way to determine if your water heater meets current code, as standards change.
